incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: rate_limiter_quota_error fired for service=redwood-api env=prod
incident-bot: Alert details: 503 from quota-enforcer, 15% of requests throttled in 1m, surge from client-tenant=acme-corp

pagerduty: Triggered incident INC-9842 (urgency: high). Primary: Anna (on-call). Escalation: Mike SRE after 5m.

Anna (on-call): acked INC-9842 :white_check_mark: I'm on it — pulling logs now. Anyone else seeing customer spikes?

Mike SRE: I see a flood of 429s in the metrics, but the enforcer itself is returning 500s intermittently. Possible quota-db timeouts.

Luis: looking at kube logs for quota-enforcer. Seeing repeated errors: `SQLSTATE 08S01: communication link failure` then `panic: runtime error` in limiter.go:237. Could be connection pool exhaustion.

Anna (on-call): thanks. Can we mute noisy alerts from the downstream services while we debug? If quota-broker is flapping we should avoid cascading pages.

Mike SRE: I'll silence infra alerts for 10m. Mute rule: `alertname="QuotaDBConnErrors"` for 10m.

Oliver (Support): Support queue already getting tickets from ACME and two other customers — they report "service failing to generate responses". Marking as potentially customer-impacting.

Julia (PM): Are we affecting embeddings/async jobs or only sync text gen paths? Need to notify account team for ACME.

Luis: rate limit enforcement sits in front of generator service for both sync and async. Metrics show 98% of throttles on /v1/chat/complete (sync).

Anna (on-call): Mitigation idea: temporarily disable quota enforcement for ACME tenant and route them to a permissive policy while we restore DB. We should also enable a soft-fail fallback that returns 429 -> pass-through when quota store is down. Thoughts?

Mike SRE: +1 for tenant-scoped temporary disable. Implement steps: 1) flip flag in config-service for tenant acme-corp to policy=permissive 2) restart quota-enforcer pods to pick up config 3) monitor for error reduction.

Luis: locating config key now: `tenants.acme-corp.policy` in Consul. I can patch with `curl -X PUT -d '{"policy":"permissive"}' https://consul/config/tenants/acme-corp` and then trigger a rolling restart using `kubectl rollout restart deploy/quota-enforcer -n prod`.

Anna (on-call): be careful with restart — we want new config read without causing more DB connections. Use `SIGHUP` if supported. If not, do a single pod restart first.

Luis: doing single pod restart on instance 3: `kubectl delete pod quota-enforcer-3 -n prod` (graceful). Patching config now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9842 acknowledged by Anna (on-call). Escalation timer paused.

Mike SRE: after patch+restart: throttles drop from 15% -> 2% in 90s. DB errors still visible but reduced. Looks like config flip helped.

Oliver (Support): ACME confirmed improvement over chat — intermittent but much better. I told them we'll follow up in a 1:1.

Julia (PM): good. Please draft customer note and include ETA for full fix.

Anna (on-call): next steps for root cause: backlog indicates quota DB connection pool limit of 100 being saturated by a misbehaving bulk-job that spawned 600 concurrent checks. Need to add circuit-breaker and backpressure. I opened an incident task.

Mike SRE: immediate follow-ups: 1) increase DB connection pool soft limit to 200 for quota-enforcer (temporary) 2) push queue-rate limit to bulk-checker 3) create circuit-breaker on quota client (ticket INF-452)

Luis: applying DB pool bump now (patch applied). Monitoring connections... they drop to steady ~80. No more SQL network errors for 10m.

Anna (on-call): setting incident status -> "mitigated". Will keep open for postmortem and customer comms. If anything regresses, page me.

incident-bot: Incident INC-9842 status updated to MITIGATED by Anna (on-call).

Mike SRE: removing temporary mute in 5m. I'll prepare a rollback plan for the permissive policy (just revert consul key).

Oliver (Support): closing urgent CS tickets for ACME. We'll send the patch notes and a recap.

Julia (PM): thanks team. Postmortem owners: Anna (on-call) and Mike SRE. Add timeline + playbook update for quota-enforcer.

Anna (on-call): assigning postmortem, will include a recommended automation to auto-fallback to permissive policy when quota-db is unresponsive, and a runbook step for tenant-scoped disables.

Mike SRE: note for follow-up: add an automated test that simulates DB latency and verifies quota-enforcer falls back gracefully.

Luis: adding logs and grafana snapshots to the incident artifact bucket.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9842 incident closed by Anna (on-call) after mitigation confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Anna (on-call): short summary for the channel: quota DB connection exhaustion caused quota-enforcer to error, resulting in widespread 429/503 responses. Temporary mitigations (tenant permissive policy + pool bump) reduced impact. Root cause and long-term fixes in postmortem. +1 to postmortem owners to keep timeline and customer comms tight.
